Create a validated configuration object

Source: R/mort_data.R
mort_config.Rd

Create a validated configuration object

Usage

mort_config(
  cause_cols = NULL,
  cause_label = "All causes",
  cause_short = "all",
  is_cause_specific = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

cause_cols

Character vector of column names to sum for this cause. Set to NULL when providing data via mort_data objects directly (i.e., not using the ONS loading path).

cause_label

Human-readable cause label.

cause_short

Short tag for filenames (must be unique across configs).

is_cause_specific

Logical; if TRUE, cap against all-causes is applied.

...

Additional named parameters that override defaults. Common overrides include forecast_h, n_sim, smoothing_method, disagg_method, pi_method, covid_years, holdout_train, holdout_test, output_dir.

Value

A mort_config object.
